subject: POC qualification & trial plan — multilingual model + fallback strategy
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@acmeco.com>, Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@acmeco.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: POC qualification & trial plan — multilingual model + fallback strategy

Hi Lina / Marco —

Thanks for the time earlier today. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we have alignment before we build the trial plan: 

Call highlights (short):
- Primary use case: real-time multilingual chat assistant for checkout support (EN/ES/FR).
- Volume profile: ~500 concurrent users during peak, average session 30–90s, ~15 tokens/turn.
- Success criteria: intent recognition >= 92% on key intents, average latency (p95) < 450ms, no regression on safety/PII filtering.
- Data constraints: logs must be retained 90 days, redaction required for PII fields per their policy.

Proposed POC scope (what Redwood will deliver):
1) 2-week sandbox run + 4-week evaluation period with production-like traffic replay.
2) Model selection: primary candidate — LlamaX-13B (quantized) for EN/ES; fallback — Mistral-v1.1 (chat-tuned) for high-latency or scale events.
3) Multilingual approach: single-model inference for EN/ES with locale-specific prompt templates; FR covered in phase 2 (unless ACME wants it in phase 1).
4) Instrumentation: token-level latency and cost breakdown, per-intent accuracy tracking (we'll ship a small eval harness and example prompts).
5) Security/compliance: SOC2 evidence checklist + VPC option if you want an isolated deployment.

Open items / asks for your team:
- Confirm FR priority (phase 1 vs phase 2).
- Share 50 representative anonymized transcripts (EN/ES) for model sanity checks.
- Legal: preferred contract SLA and any procurement timing.

Next steps (suggested):
- ACME to confirm FR inclusion and send transcripts by 2026-12-03.
- Redwood to deliver a POC success criteria workbook and a concrete timeline by 2026-12-04.
- Quick sync Wednesday 11:00am PT to finalize scope (30m).

Attached: placeholder success criteria workbook (we'll iterate) — ACME_POC_success_criteria.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward.

—
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@acmeco.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@acmeco.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 18:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC qualification & trial plan — multilingual model + fallback strategy

Thanks Logan — very clear, appreciate the write-up. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) FR: we want French in the trial as well if it doesn't add major complexity. Our EU legal lead is likely to ask for it. If including FR pushes timeline by more than one week, put it in phase 2.
2) Transcripts: we'll provide a mix of live chat and SMS transcripts — want them anonymized and delivered via the secure drive link. Is that okay?
3) Fallback model: Mistral is fine; we just want to understand how you plan to route to it (e.g., auto-fallback on latency threshold vs manual routing).

Procurement timing: procurement expects an initial SOW and an estimate by 2026-12-10. We're okay with the proposed 2-week sandbox + 4-week evaluation, but procurement will need a clear cost estimate for Dedicated capacity if we exceed sandbox thresholds.

We'll aim to upload transcripts by EOD 2026-12-03. Confirmed for Wednesday 11:00am PT.

-Lina
Sr. Product Manager, ACME Commerce
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@acmeco.com>, Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@acmeco.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC qualification & trial plan — multilingual model + fallback strategy

Great — thanks for the quick turnaround, Lina. A few clarifications from our engineering/product side (summarized):

- FR inclusion: engineering estimates +5 business days to add FR to the prompt templates and eval harness. We'll keep the main traffic split for EN/ES but enable FR sampling in the sandbox.

- Transcripts via secure drive is perfect. We'll provide a small ingest script and a checklist to ensure PII is redacted per your standards. See attached SOC2 evidence request for data retention/controls (SOC2-evidence-request.xlsx).

- Fallback routing plan (high level):
  * Primary: LlamaX-13B quantized (fast-path)
  * Fallback triggers: p95 latency > 600ms OR token compute error OR explicit model-degraded signal from safety filter
  * Fallback behavior: route to Mistral-v1.1 with conservative decoding settings; capture outbound confidence score and fall back to cached templated answer if both models low-confidence.

Action items and owners:
- ACME: upload transcripts to shared drive by 2026-12-03 (Lina / Marco)
- Redwood (Logan): share finalized POC workbook + timeline by 2026-12-04
- Redwood (Priya): draft SOW template + cost range for sandbox vs Dedicated by 2026-12-07
- Redwood (Rishi): provide a short doc on multilingual prompt templates and fallback routing logic by 2026-12-04

Attaching: initial POC success criteria workbook (starter) and SOC2 evidence checklist.

Thanks — I'll prepare the meeting agenda for Wednesday and include a 10-min walkthrough of the routing plan.

—
Logan
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@acmeco.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC qualification & trial plan — multilingual model + fallback strategy

Adding a quick engineering note on the model-choice and evaluation metrics so ACME has visibility before the sync: 

- Why LlamaX-13B primary: small memory footprint when quantized, predictable latency at shorter context lengths (your session sizes fit well). We'll run the eval harness on your sample transcripts to sanity-check intent recognition/rewrite needs.
- Multilingual handling: we'll run locale detection upstream (lightweight classifier) and route same request but swap prompt templates per language. This keeps KV cache reuse high across languages if user switches mid-session.
- Fallback detail: we'll implement a soft-fallback first — allow Mistral only for the next N tokens if primary stalls, log both outputs and compute agreement score. If agreement < threshold, escalate to templated fallback.

Eval plan (deliverables):
1) Automated eval run on provided transcripts (intent accuracy, entity extraction correctness, safety false positives/negatives).
2) Latency and cost projections at 5, 25, 90, 500 concurrent users.
3) Short README describing prompt templates and sample prompt pairs.

I'll publish the short doc by EOD 2026-12-04. If ACME wants a separate FR language model instead of single-model multilingual, flag it in the sync and we'll provide tradeoffs.

-Rishi
Staff ML Engineer, Redwood Inference
